forgexSolutions.name: Revenue Leak Check
forgexSolutions.description: One-week audit ($500 fixed price, credited toward any fix ordered within 30 days) measuring how many calls, web form submissions, and quotes slip through across phone and web channels.
forgexSolutions.problem: Potential delay or leakage between paid ad clicks, static WordPress form submissions, and booked jobs in dispatch.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Even when a contractor owns field-service software, an independent audit across website forms, call tracking numbers, and inbox logs identifies where leads are dropping before configuring or building automation.

forgexSolutions.name: Lead-to-job pipeline
forgexSolutions.description: Automated pipeline ($1,800 setup plus $149/month) ensuring every web form and lead source lands in the field-service software within two minutes, triggers an instant SMS/email reply, and alerts dispatch until followed up.
forgexSolutions.problem: Static WordPress forms on Contact Us and Schedule Service may rely on manual email reading at [redacted] before a lead is entered and contacted.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: If their current WordPress form setup is not natively pushing structured lead records into their dispatch queue with instant two-minute SMS replies, a lightweight webhook-to-API bridge solves it without redesigning the website.

forgexSolutions.name: Owner's Monday numbers
forgexSolutions.description: Automated weekly one-page report ($1,200 setup plus $99/month) showing booked revenue, close rate, average ticket, cost per booked job by lead source, and accounts receivable.
forgexSolutions.problem: Reconciling return on ad spend across Google Ads, Bing Ads, Facebook, and third-party ad trackers against actual booked plumbing revenue.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Native field-service dashboards often require complex ad-account mapping or high-tier marketing add-ons to combine multi-channel ad spend and accounting receivables into a single Monday digest.

feasibility.explanation: The website runs on a standard stack with WordPress forms (frm.min.js) and already includes SMS opt-in checkboxes for appointment reminders and text communications on both the Contact Us and Schedule Service forms. Connecting form webhooks, email parsing, and ad-spend APIs to dispatch software is technically straightforward.

aiDelivery.explanation: Deterministic workflow automation (webhooks, API integrations, and scheduled data aggregation) should handle lead routing, instant SMS confirmation, and weekly KPI reporting. AI agents are well-suited for classifying free-text form messages, triaging the shared [redacted] inbox, and drafting initial responses, while human dispatchers must control emergency prioritization and technician assignment.

humanReview: Human dispatcher verification for any lead indicating an active plumbing emergency (such as burst pipes, active flooding, or sewage backups).
Human approval before finalizing technician dispatch assignments or modifying schedule slots.
Human review of drafted replies in the [redacted] inbox before sending non-standard quotes or commercial commitments.

risks.description: Automated SMS replies must strictly respect the user's SMS opt-in checkbox state on the Contact Us and Schedule Service forms and honor STOP/HELP commands under TCPA and carrier 10DLC rules.

Plumbing Solutions of Idaho advertises 24/7 emergency response; an automated reply must never give a customer with an active water leak the false impression that a truck is already rolling before a live dispatcher or on-call tech confirms.
Customer names, phone numbers, emails, and service addresses must be transmitted over encrypted connections with least-privilege API credentials.

commercial.value: Illustrative: $495 per month ($5,940 per year) at the baseline promotional service level, calculated from the site's published $99 Water Heater Flush price times an assumed 5 additional captured leads per month (standard repair and installation prices are not listed on the website).
commercial.implementationCost: $500 fixed price for the Revenue Leak Check (credited in full toward any fix ordered within 30 days); $1,800 setup plus $149/month for the Lead-to-job pipeline; or $1,200 setup plus $99/month for Owner's Monday numbers.
assumptions: The only specific service price published on the website is the $99 Water Heater Flush (alongside a $50 Off Any Plumbing Service coupon) on https://plumbingsolutionsofidaho.com/about/coupons/.
Assumes 5 otherwise-missed or delayed web/phone leads per month are converted into booked jobs at the $99 published price ($99 x 5 = $495/month illustrative baseline).
Standard diagnostic, repair, sewer, and installation ticket prices are not published on the website and are therefore excluded from this calculation.

discovery.outreachSubject: Quick note on your Schedule Service form / Plumbing Solutions of Idaho
discovery.outreachBody:
Hi Plumbing Solutions of Idaho team,

I was looking through plumbingsolutionsofidaho.com and noticed a couple of small items on your site that might be costing you leads:

1. On your Schedule Service page, the 'Service Needed' dropdown asks customers to choose between 'Air Conditioning' and 'Heating' alongside Plumbing, Sewers, and Drains.
2. Your Coupons page still shows 2025 expiration dates (5/31/25 and 7/31/25).

Even if you have your web agency clean those up, I wanted to ask how those WordPress form submissions currently reach your dispatch board. I run ForgeX—we help home-service contractors connect their web forms and call/lead channels directly into their field-service software with an instant reply in under two minutes.

We offer a fixed-price $500 Revenue Leak Check where, in one week, we audit how many calls, web leads, and quotes slip through the cracks (and the $500 is credited in full if you order a fix within 30 days). We don't promise specific results, and if your current software already handles this end-to-end, we'll tell you straight up.

Would the owner or operations manager be open to a 10-minute chat next week?

Best regards,

[FOUNDER NAME]
[FOUNDER TITLE], ForgeX

[FORGEX PHONE / WEBSITE]

If you prefer not to receive future emails from us, simply reply with "unsubscribe" or [OPT-OUT MECHANISM] and we will remove you immediately.
